# Iowa DIAL (Department of Inspections, Appeals, & Licensing)

> > Iowa's centralized licensing and regulatory authority for health professionals, trades, real estate, and workplace safety.

DIAL manages professional licensing across Iowa through the My Iowa PLB portal, oversees boards including the Iowa Board of Pharmacy and Board of Respiratory Care, and administers workers' compensation hearings. The department enforces Iowa Code and Administrative Code requirements for license applications, renewals, and background checks.

## Key Topics

- Professional licensing in Iowa
- My Iowa PLB portal
- License renewal procedures
- Iowa Board of Pharmacy
- Iowa Board of Respiratory Care
- Background checks and FBI clearance
- NAPLEX and MPJE exams
- NBRC certification
- CNA and DCW Registry
- Workers' compensation hearings
- Real estate licensure
- VeriDoc verification system
- Iowa Code section 157.3A
- Continuing education requirements
- License verification services

## Health Professions Licensing

- [Pharmacist Licensure](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/health-professions/pharmacy/pharmacist-licensure): Iowa pharmacist licensure pathways, NAPLEX, MPJE, and requirements
- [About the Board of Pharmacy](https://dial.iowa.gov/about-dial/boards-and-commissions/pharmacy/about): Iowa Board of Pharmacy mission, members, and contact information
- [Respiratory Care & Polysomnography](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/health-professions/respiratory-care): Respiratory care licensing requirements and NBRC certification overview
- [Verify the Status of a CNA on the Iowa DCW Registry](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/medical/direct-care/how-do-i-verify-cna-status): CNA verification guide for employers using Iowa DCW Registry
- [Physician License Verifications](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/health-professions/physicians/verifications): Medical license verification requests via VeriDoc for Iowa physicians

## License Renewal & Application Processes

- [Renew My License](https://dial.iowa.gov/how-do-i-renewal-0): License renewal guide for real estate appraisers and brokers in Iowa
- [Renew a Tattoo Artist Permit](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/tattoo/tattoo-artist-permits/how-do-i-artist-renewal-instructions): Tattoo artist permit renewal instructions using Iowa's online portal
- [Apply for a Barbering & Cosmetology Certification](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/barbering-cosmetology/licensure/how-do-i-certification-specialized-services): Barbering & cosmetology certification guide for specialized services
- [Renew a Swimming Pool Facility Online](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/swimming-pools-spas/registration-renewals/how-do-i-pool-spa-renewal-instructions): Swimming pool facility registration renewal via ADPER-EH system

## Professional Boards & Online Services

- [Board of Medicine Online Services](https://dial.iowa.gov/about-dial/boards/medicine/online-services): Board of Medicine online services for licensing and complaint filing
- [Accountants](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/other-professional-licensure/accountants): Iowa Accountancy Board CPA licensure and continuing education info

## Workers' Compensation & Hearings

- [Workers' Compensation Hearings](https://dial.iowa.gov/hearings/workers-comp/hearings): Workers' Compensation Division hearings and scheduling information

## Background Checks & Verification

- [Criminal History Background for Real Estate](https://dial.iowa.gov/licenses/other-professional-licensure/real-estate-licensees/re-criminal-history): FBI background check process for Iowa real estate licensees via DataPro
